title: F5: one scoped correction record ("Teach Once")
description: A single stored correction: a scope-declared, typed piece of steering context the user explicitly confirmed -- NEVER an inferred or auto-applied preference. This is deliberately NOT the deleted prompt-mode memory-card system (cut 2026-07-27; see clozn/server/message_assembly.py's module docstring): a card was proposed by the product and auto-applied by a topic-relevance gate reading message content. A correction is drafted and confirmed by an explicit user action, and it is selected for a run ONLY by exact equality against a caller-declared scope key (clozn.runs.corrections.resolve_corrections) -- never by matching its `content` against a prompt. `content` is opaque payload text to every selection path in this codebase; nothing reads it to decide applicability. `enabled` and `confirmed_ts` are separate facts on purpose: `confirmed_ts` is set exactly once, by confirm_correction(), and is never re-set by disable/enable -- it records WHEN the user explicitly agreed to this correction's content, which stays true regardless of later on/off toggling. A drafted-but-unconfirmed correction (confirmed_ts absent) is never selected by resolve_corrections() -- see that function's own SQL predicate, which is the structural enforcement point, not a convention checked in application code. This artifact makes no claim about model weights: a correction is delivered context, declared and receipted, never a training signal.

scope.description: Exactly one scope kind, always explicit -- never inferred from context. `value` is the opaque scope key the kind is checked against (clozn.runs.association.session_key/client_key/project_key for session/client/project, a model_sha256 hex digest for model) and is present for every kind except global_local, which applies install-wide and carries no value (omitted, never null-padded).

value.description: session_<24hex> / client_<24hex> / project_<24hex> (clozn.runs.association) for those three kinds; a 64-hex-char model_sha256 digest for 'model'; absent for 'global_local'.

type.description: The ONLY axis used to group corrections as conflict candidates (clozn.runs.corrections resolve_corrections groups strictly by this field, never by comparing `content` -- there is no semantic-similarity signal in this codebase to compare free text with, and inventing one here would be exactly the relevance-matching this schema exists to rule out).

content.description: The correction text itself, e.g. 'Always cite sources with URLs.' Opaque payload: no code path in clozn/runs/corrections.py reads this field to decide whether the correction applies. Present while the correction is live; removed (not null-padded) once delete_correction() scrubs it -- content_hash below survives that scrub so a run's receipt entry referencing this correction's hash stays checkable even after deletion.

content_hash.description: sha256(content)[:16], computed once when the correction is drafted (content is immutable from that point through confirm/disable/enable -- only delete_correction() ever changes it, by removing it) and never recomputed -- the same stability contract clozn.runs.context_receipt's segment_id uses. Retained forever, including after `content` is scrubbed by delete_correction(), so every past applied_corrections receipt entry that cites this id remains checkable against the same hash.

enabled.description: Whether resolve_corrections() may currently select this correction. False for a freshly drafted (unconfirmed) correction, a disabled one, and a deleted one. Toggling this NEVER rewrites confirmed_ts or content_hash, and NEVER touches past correction_events application rows -- disable is reversible and non-destructive of history by construction, not by convention.

confirmed_ts.description: Set exactly once, by the explicit confirm_correction() call. Absent for a drafted-but-unconfirmed correction -- resolve_corrections() requires this field to be present (SQL: confirmed_ts IS NOT NULL) before a correction is even a candidate, so an unconfirmed draft cannot be selected regardless of enabled/scope/type.

disabled_ts.description: Timestamp of the most recent disable, if the correction is currently disabled. Cleared (omitted) on re-enable; the underlying correction_events ledger keeps every transition regardless.

deleted_ts.description: Present once delete_correction() has scrubbed `content`. Deletion is permanent within this schema -- unlike disable, a deleted correction cannot be undone (see clozn.runs.corrections.undo_last_change); its content_hash and every correction_events row survive so past receipts remain checkable.
